$comment: Source registry. Every provenance sourceId must appear here. Only list retrievals that actually happened. Human-readable detail: docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (via Overpass API)
sources.accessNotes: Queried through the public Overpass API (https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter); no account. Usage policy: under 10,000 queries and 1 GB per day; run tools/fetch-osm.ts rarely and commit snapshots.

licence.name: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0

sources.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Data available under the Open Database License (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright).
obligations: Display the attribution wherever the data or anything produced from it is shown.
Derived databases that are publicly used or distributed must be offered under ODbL (share-alike).
Crowd-sourced: completeness and accuracy are not guaranteed; signal and switch tagging is partial.

retrievals.description: Railway extract for the shrewsbury bbox (52.695-52.745 N, 2.770-2.725 W), including named junctions, yards and level crossings (data/raw/osm/shrewsbury-2026-10-27.json), overpass-api.de. Supersedes an earlier same-day extract (base 2026-10-27T16:01:40Z) with a smaller bbox.

sources.name: Network Rail Open Data Feeds (SCHEDULE, CORPUS, SMART, BPLAN, TD, TRUST, VSTP)
sources.accessNotes: Free account required; first come first served, capped at 1,000 users. Static files (SCHEDULE CIF/JSON, CORPUS, SMART) are downloaded with authenticated HTTP GET. The user must register and download files; this project does not hold credentials. SMART: supplied by the owner on 2026-10-27 (data/private/SMARTExtract.json).

licence.name: Network Rail Infrastructure Limited Data Feeds Licence: use under the Open Government Licence (version not stated on the licence page; OGL v3.0 is current)

sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
obligations: Do not use the Network Rail brand or logo, or those of National Rail or train companies.
Do not describe the application as 'official'.
Attribution uses the OGL v3.0 default statement because the licence page gives no specific wording (decision D-009); replace it if Network Rail specifies one.
Raw extracts stay in git-ignored data/private/; only derived study-area snapshots are committed.

retrievals.version: SCHEDULE full CIF, header DFROC1F, extracted 2026-10-23T20:01, valid 2026-10-23..2027-10-23
retrievals.description: toc-full.CIF downloaded by the project owner into data/private/ (date derived from the local file timestamp, not from a download record; correct only on reliable evidence).
CORPUS downloaded by the project owner into data/private/ (date derived from the local file timestamp, not from a download record; correct only on reliable evidence).

retrievals.version: SMARTExtract.json, 34,298 berth rows (no extract date in the file; per-row COMMENT dates are free text and include an obvious typo, 28/06/2206)
retrievals.description: SMART downloaded by the project owner into data/private/ (date derived from the local file timestamp, not from a download record; correct only on reliable evidence).

sources.notes: Primary candidate for timetable (SCHEDULE full CIF extract, weekly on Fridays) and for TIPLOC/STANOX/CRS (CORPUS) and TD berth-to-location reference data (SMART).

sources.name: Rail Delivery Group timetable feed (CIF, passenger services only)
sources.accessNotes: Weekly timetable via the National Rail Data Portal for development use; regular feeds require an RSP data licence and fee.

licence.name: RSP data licence / portal terms (not reviewed)

obligations: Licence not reviewed; do not import until terms are read.
sources.notes: Excludes non-passenger (freight, ECS) services, which matter for signalling gameplay. Fallback only.

sources.name: OpenRailwayMap
sources.accessNotes: Rendered map of OSM railway data. Used by humans to cross-check OSM tagging; nothing is imported from it.

licence.name: Underlying data ODbL (OpenStreetMap); tile licence not reviewed

obligations: Do not embed tiles without reviewing the tile licence and usage policy.

sources.name: Network Rail National Electronic Sectional Appendix
sources.accessNotes: Published as PDFs on the Network Rail website. Not yet located or downloaded by this project.

licence.name: Copyright Network Rail; reuse terms not reviewed

obligations: Treat as reference to corroborate line names, speeds and signal box limits; do not republish extracts until terms are reviewed.

sources.name: Wikipedia (English)
obligations: Facts only; no text copied. Use as corroboration, not as an authoritative railway source.
